DeleteAccount.title: Delete your Almond account
DeleteAccount.goesBody: Your name, date of birth and gender, and the comments you wrote on your ratings.
DeleteAccount.staysBody: Your phone number, points and wallet balance stay linked to your number, and points expire only on their usual dates, so they are yours again if you sign in with the same number. Your past orders and invoices are kept as they are.
DeleteAccount.whenBody: Your account is deleted {days} days after you ask. Signing in before then cancels the request.
